foley.settings.title: Foley
foley.settings.unavailable: Foley's sound synthesis isn't running, so there's nothing to set. The game log says why.
foley.settings.volume.tooltip: How loud Foley's sounds are, under the game's own Weather, Blocks and Ambient sliders. At 0%, Foley is off.
foley.settings.rain.tooltip: Foley's rain falls on what's round you, at the weather's rate, and drums on any roof over you. The game's is one recording.
foley.settings.thunder.tooltip: Foley's thunder comes from each flash's own channel, arriving as late as sound takes: near strikes crack, far ones rumble.
foley.settings.wind.tooltip: Wind that rises with height and the weather, gusts, rustles leaves and drops when you're sheltered. The game has none.
foley.settings.water.tooltip: Foley's streams babble and its waterfalls roar from where they are. The game's water is an occasional recording.
foley.settings.drips.tooltip: Foley's drips ring as they land in water, tick on stone, or sizzle as lava.
foley.settings.fire.tooltip: Foley's fire roars and puffs, and crackles more the more is burning.
foley.settings.lava.tooltip: Foley's lava rumbles, and its bubbles burst and ring.
foley.settings.strikes.tooltip: Under the game's sounds for mining, placing, landing and breaking: the block's own ring, from what it's made of. Glass shatters.
foley.settings.footsteps.tooltip: Under the game's step sounds: each heel strike on the block, with gravel crunching and snow squeaking.
foley.settings.birds.tooltip: Birdsong from the trees by day, most at dawn. Each biome has its own species.
foley.settings.rarerSpecies.tooltip: Adds rarely-heard birds: Kori bustard on savannas, golden eagle above jagged peaks, alpine chough in the high mountains.
foley.settings.crickets.tooltip: Crickets in the grass on warm nights, chirping faster the warmer it is.
foley.settings.frogs.tooltip: Frogs calling from still water at night and in the rain.
foley.settings.minecarts.tooltip: Minecart wheels on rails, louder on powered rails; a rush when a cart passes at speed.
foley.settings.doors.tooltip: Wooden and iron doors creak open and shut, and trapdoors with them.
foley.settings.chests.tooltip: Chests, ender chests and shulker boxes open and close with a soft puff.
foley.settings.redstone.tooltip: A click when a repeater or comparator changes state.
foley.settings.boats.tooltip: Water laps at a boat's hull, faster the faster the boat moves.
foley.settings.sculk.tooltip: A sculk sensor rings when it triggers, and the sculk around it rings back.
foley.settings.bypass.unbound: Bind "Bypass Foley" in Controls to switch Foley off and on while you listen.
foley.settings.bypass.bound: Press %s to switch Foley off and on while you listen.
foley.bypass.on: Foley off: the game's own sounds
foley.settings.voices.note: Foley can make these mobs' calls from a model of their voices, sized by their anatomy (zombies breathe heavier as they close in), or from what they're made of. Each keeps the game's until you choose Foley.
foley.settings.voice.tooltip: Foley's voice: a source–filter model, its pitch and formants from the mob's size. Its ambient, hurt and death calls, in every variant.
foley.settings.voices.all_game: Give All Mobs the Game's Voices
foley.settings.caveAtmosphere.tooltip: Cave atmosphere (M12): drips from a low stone roof and a sub-bass rumble in deep caves, off by default. The game's own cave sounds are sparse; Foley's is continuous.
foley.settings.underwater.tooltip: Bubbles rise past your ear and a low tone builds with depth when your head is under water. Emerged, Foley sounds the same as above.
foley.settings.aeolian.tooltip: Whistles from iron bars, fences, lanterns, bells and bamboo when the wind blows past: the faster the wind, the higher the pitch.
foley.settings.biomeBeds.tooltip: Each biome's own ambient bed (desert hiss, mushroom hum, lush/dripstone cave colors, deep dark drone, snow hush, mangrove drone).
foley.settings.desertBeds.tooltip: Desert and badlands: a granular sand hiss underfoot, a hollow wind whistle on the open plain, and a slow vortex whoosh when the wind's up.
foley.settings.mushroomHum.tooltip: A low ambient hum unique to the mushroom biome, fading outside it.
foley.settings.caveColors.tooltip: Each cave biome gets its own bed: a high-frequency moss hiss in lush caves, more drips and less rumble in dripstone caves.
foley.settings.deepDark.tooltip: A subsonic ~30 Hz drone and scuttling sculk sensors as one-shots.
foley.settings.snowyHush.tooltip: High-frequency absorption: a slow LPF in cold biomes, the wind and other Foley beds muffled.
foley.settings.mangroveDrone.tooltip: A humid insect drone, louder the more mangrove leaves are around.
foley.settings.settling.tooltip: A tiny delayed tick after footsteps and block placement on gravel, sand or snow.
foley.settings.mob_brushes.tooltip: Sheep, spiders and chickens brushing through plants as they move.
foley.settings.peaceful_breathing.toolti: Cows and sheep breathe quietly when Foley voices them.
foley.settings.ash_drift.tooltip: A faint high-frequency wash during blizzards and ash storms.
